newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-YUGOSLAVIA NAME PROVISIONAL SQUAD FOR WORLD CUP GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YUGOSLAVIA NAME PROVISIONAL SQUAD FOR WORLD CUP GAME.

text.p: Yugoslav coach Slobodan Santrach named a provisional squad on Monday for the World Cup qualifying match against Slovakia in Belgrade on June 8.
Santrach is expected to whittle the 27 names down to 20 next Monday.
Yugoslavia are lying second in group six with 16 points, one behind Spain and four ahead of Slovakia who have two games in hand.
Goalkeepers - Ivica Kralj (Partizan Belgrade), Dragoje Lekovic (Kilmarnock), Aleksandar Kocic (ex-Perugia).

Defenders - Zoran Mirkovic (Atalanta), Goran Djorovic (Red Star Belgrade), Miroslav Djukic (Deportivo Coruna), Sinisa Mihajlovic (Sampdoria), Nisa Saveljic (Partizan Belgrade), Misko Mirkovic (Kojaeli), Ljubisa Dunjerski (Vojvodina), Risto Vidakovic (Real Betis), Albert Nadj (Betis).

Midfielders - Dragan Stojkovic (Nagoya Grampus Eight), Dejan Savicevic (AC Milan), Slavisa Jokanovic (Tenerife), Dejan Govedarica (Volendam), Vladimir Jugovic (Juventus), Branko Brnovic (Espanyol), Ljubinko Drulovic (Porto), Dragan Ciric (Partizan Belgrade), Zeljko Petrovic (PSV Eindhoven), Miroslav Stevic (Munich 1860), Damir Cakar (Partizan Belgrade).
Strikers - Predrag Mijatovic (Real Madrid), Savo Milosevic (Aston Villa), Anto Drobnjak (Bastia), Darko Kovacevic (Real Sociedad).
